facts.fact_text: On 22 February 2003 two police officers took the applicant to the Central District Police Department of Yerevan.
At the Central District Police Department of Yerevan, an administrative case was initiated against the applicant on account of his participation in the demonstration of 21 February 2003.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
The applicant was taken to a detention facility following his sentencing.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.
Judge H. found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration in Yerevan.
A summary of the relevant provisions concerning administrative proceedings is contained in the judgment in the case of Galstyan v. Armenia (no. 26986/03, § 26, 15 November 2007).

A summary of the relevant legislation invoked by the parties in connection with Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO) is contained in the judgment in the case of Mkrtchyan v. Armenia (no. 6562/03, §§ 20-28, 11 January 2007).
Judge H. found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated together with a group of people in an unauthorised demonstration in Yerevan.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found that on 21 February 2003 the applicant participated in an unauthorised demonstration and street march, during which he violated public order.
Judge H. sentenced the applicant under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (Վարչական իրավախախտումների վերաբերյալ ՀՀ օրենսգիրք – "the CAO") to 15 days of administrative detention.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal found, having reviewed the applicant's appeal and the materials concerning the administrative offence, that the penalty imposed on the applicant must be changed.

The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal changed the applicant's penalty to an administrative fine of 1,000 Armenian drams (AMD), which was approximately 1.5 euros (EUR) at the material time.
The President of the Criminal and Military Court of Appeal ordered the applicant's release from detention.
The applicant alleged that he was not allowed to reply to the letter from his wife that was brought to him in the detention facility by the Red Cross representative.

The applicant alleged that, on an unspecified date, his wife had verbally requested the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan to review its decision sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.

The applicant's wife was notified by a letter of 25 February 2003 that the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan had no competence to review its decision sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.

On 27 February 2003 the applicant's lawyer lodged an application with the General Prosecutor (ՀՀ գլխավոր դատախազ) requesting the General Prosecutor to initiate an appeal against the decision of the Kentron and Nork-Marash District Court of Yerevan sentencing the applicant to 15 days of administrative detention.
The applicant's lawyer had apparently received by mistake a copy of a decision taken in respect of a person convicted in a different administrative case, identified as H.A.

The applicant's lawyer argued that the applicant had been unlawfully found guilty under Article 180.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (the CAO) by a decision taken in respect of another person, H.A.
The applicant's lawyer argued that the applicant had been unlawfully deprived of his liberty by a decision taken in respect of another person, H.A.
